purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer-route outcomes, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: First-party Xinjiang/Bingtuan sources establish the Eighth Division Shihezi Real Estate Registration Center and general cadastral-map inquiry context. No current anonymous safe ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody found through the official Bingtuan Natural Resources Bureau report naming the Eighth Division Shihezi Real Estate Registration Center and describing its registration operations. The Xinjiang Natural Resources Department guidance is general service context, not proof of a current public Shihezi parcel layer.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Bingtuan Natural Resources Bureau report says the Eighth Division Shihezi Real Estate Registration Center was established on 2016-06-29 and describes the local registration hall and integrated registration operations.

Official Xinjiang Natural Resources Department guidance describes real-estate registration and cadastral-map inquiry practice, including parcel and building-plan map concepts; it does not publish a Shihezi parcel API.
